test_title: PYST 56: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the son of B’,

A − B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the brother of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

Based on the above, how is P related to R if ‘P × S ÷ M − T + R’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is

Given: P × S ÷ M − T + R

P × S → P is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cb610e973505ef4599f633dae45e02511028c245daff838057467746271b8b8.png] 

S ÷ M → S is the daughter of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/068441e4d825e8f3ee6ff3c1c398d233b18e3fb7595d5a46d9bdfc2ce4edcabd.png] 

M − T → M is the wife of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66793c5aaed7f921ec3430f32d6fbb566d5ea9e7acaf6d055df0475fa3c6494d.png] 

T + R → T is the son of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d44ad6fec7da3b0d8357833332733e978bbbda17fe38565aacb9d8556c5f48e8.png] 

Thus, P is R's grandson or son’s son.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
